main_claim: Dana White says Justin Gaethje still looked incredible and has a lot of money left to make, while the big question is whether Topuria fights Gaethje or Pimblett next.
note: The piece is Gaethje's story (retirement, money), but White's quote 'Is he going to fight Gaethje, or is he going to fight Paddy Pimblett?' names Topuria's options from the promotion, which the guide puts at status_update, not next_fight; an editor could read White's line as musing (no_fact, act none_of_these) and Topuria as only_mentioned since the loss is recapped and 'ready to fight' is the writer's line.

main_claim: Merab Dvalishvili says Topuria is fine, positive, enjoying life and will beat everyone when he returns.
note: Friend Dvalishvili, 'para actualizar su estado físico y mental', says 'Topuria está bien... Es muy fuerte, tanto física como mentalmente' — a named person saying how he is, so health; the closed fractures and 2027 return are the writer's recap, and Tsarukyan/Pimblett/Makhachev are options only, so next fight is no. An editor could call Merab's words status_update (enjoying life away from the cage) rather than a recovery update.

main_claim: Paddy Pimblett says nobody from the UFC has approached him about a rumoured December fight with Topuria.
note: Tim Welch 'claimed he heard rumors that Pimblett and Topuria could meet before the end of the year' and Pimblett says 'No one spoke to me about it' — a named rumour with a month, denied by its subject, so next_fight at rumour; Pimblett is not booked, so other_fighter_side. Topuria could be only_mentioned since it is Pimblett's story, and 'I'd love to smash his head in' could make the act calls_him_out.

main_claim: Donchenko beat Punahele Soriano by unanimous decision at UFC Fight Night 287 in Paris for his fourth UFC win.
note: A round-by-round fight report ending 'UD 3 (30–27, 30–27, 29–28)'; nobody speaks and the embedded UFC tweet is not his words.

main_claim: Paddy Pimblett says he would love to destroy Topuria but nobody has spoken to him about a fight, while the article weighs Topuria's two options, a Gaethje rematch or Pimblett.
note: Built around Topuria's future ('solo parece haber esas dos opciones') with Pimblett's quote 'Me encantaría destrozarle la cabeza... Nadie me ha hablado de eso'; the 'corrillos' talk has no who, when or where, so like a wish piece it is no_fact, and the January attempt to book Pimblett is recalled as known background. An editor could pick one_of_several (both stars' futures), next_fight at rumour for the denied talk, or steers_him for the writer's analysis.

main_claim: Donchenko beat Soriano by unanimous decision in Paris for his fourth straight UFC win and asked for Daniel Rodriguez next.
note: A fight account ending '30:27, 30:27, 29:28'; his wish to fight Rodriguez is only described ('заявив про бажання'), not quoted, so he does not speak and next fight is no.

main_claim: Former fighter Matt Brown says Topuria should take a tune-up fight such as Moicano before any Gaethje rematch, or the rematch could ruin his life.
note: Brown's 'you need to put him in there with someone like a Moicano' is sincere advice from a former fighter (a fighter is a fighter); the orbital fractures and the stool are recapped background. Jon Anik 'indicated the UFC is weighing a potential Gaethje-Topuria sequel' is the premise of the opinion piece, so no_fact here, but an editor could take it as a named rumour and mark next_fight at rumour.

main_claim: PFL champion Usman Nurmagomedov disputes that only UFC fighters are elite, picking apart the UFC lightweight top 10 including Topuria.
note: Topuria is one name in Nurmagomedov's list ('17-0 Topuria, who had been praising himself as the greatest, he lost, quit on the stool'), his loss retold in another fighter's argument about the sport; the dig at his performance is a thin assesses_him, and none_of_these or calls_him_out are reasonable.

main_claim: The León sports forum announces Carolina Marín, Carlos Moyá and Dr Aldo Martínez, Topuria's director of sports performance, as its first speakers.
note: Topuria appears only as the fighter Martínez works for ('responsable de rendimiento deportivo de Ilia Topuria'); the forum's speaker announcement is an event with nobody speaking, so no_one, though the organisers fit no listed source and an editor could pick his_team since Martínez is the subject. Nobody does anything regarding Topuria, hence act none_of_these.

main_claim: Donchenko beat Punahele Soriano by unanimous decision at UFC Fight Night 287 in Paris, his fourth UFC win in a row.
note: A results note citing Tribuna with the scores '30:27, 30:27, 29:28'; his February and June wins are recalled as background.

main_claim: A preview of Donchenko vs Soriano in Paris: a top-15 entry ticket for both, with the writer leaning to a Donchenko win but warning it may be his hardest UFC fight.
note: A preview covering both fighters at length ('я все ж таки схиляюся до перемоги Донченка'), which the guide lists as one_of_several though it is framed around him; the booking is the premise, so next fight is no. 'Вперше в кар'єрі Данило битиметься в основному карді' is a card-order fact an editor could take as fight_week_event.

main_claim: Donchenko knocked Soriano down in round one and won by unanimous decision at UFC Fight Night 287 in Paris.
note: A fight report with the scores '30:27, 30:27, 29:28'; the TUF win and earlier fights are background and the UFC tweets are not his words.

main_claim: Donchenko's next fight is set for 5 September at UFC Fight Night in Paris against Punahele Soriano.
note: A booking announcement stated flatly ('проведе свій наступний поєдинок 5 вересня... Суперником... стане Пунахеле Соріано') with nobody quoted; the outlet gives no source, so an editor could call it reported rather than official. His past wins are background.

main_claim: Justin Gaethje says the lightweight division is cleaned out and floats Conor McGregor for his first title defence.
note: Gaethje's own story about his next defence; Topuria appears as the man he beat and as the reason to skip Holloway and Oliveira ('since Topuria beat them'), nothing new about him. Gaethje, who fought him, is opponent_side but does nothing regarding Topuria, hence act none_of_these.

main_claim: In a long interview after his Paris win Donchenko reviews the fight, reveals a hand infection and hospital stay a month before it, and talks about Rodriguez, Usman and his year.
note: He himself states 'у мене була інфекція 4 серпня... Був у госпіталі, мені різали руку... пив антибіотики, повноцінно тренуватися не міг' — a health fact in his own words, as with the fractures essay; the interview is otherwise reflection, so an editor could call it no_fact since the infection is past and prompted by the interviewer. His wish for Rodriguez and talk of Usman are wishes, so next fight is no; the win is retold after the fact, so result is no.
